description: Carmel ShopRite Plaza is a well-established community shopping center strategically positioned on Route 52 in Carmel, New York, serving the affluent Putnam County market. Spanning 145,466 square feet, this thriving retail destination is anchored by ShopRite supermarket and complemented by 52 Fitness and Box Office Cinemas, creating a compelling mix of grocery, wellness, and entertainment options. The center's prime location less than one mile from downtown Carmel and just minutes from Interstate 84 provides exceptional accessibility for the surrounding community of over 18,000 residents. With an impressive 1.8 million annual visits and a 4.5-star rating from over 100 reviews, the plaza has established itself as a trusted neighborhood hub. The trade area demographics are particularly strong, with average household incomes exceeding $142,000 and home values approaching half a million dollars, supporting a stable tenant base and consistent foot traffic throughout the week.
